sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term stability is highly valued in our family-run foundry. However, the prices you suggested do not reflect the reality of our current cost structures and the quality we consistently deliver. 

In recognition of the extended contract term, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.40 while maintaining the 30-day payment terms. Our offer is a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement towards a mutually viable agreement. 

As a family foundry with deep roots in our region, we value the trust built between our companies over many years. To support our shared future, we can propose a price of €50.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

This represents a significant step from our side to finalize this agreement and continue our long-standing partnership. Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to taking this next step together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued steps toward an agreement. 

For generations, our foundry has taken immense pride in delivering the highest quality to our valued partners in the region. To bring this negotiation to a successful conclusion, we are prepared to offer €50.00 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. For complete clarity, our offer is a price of €50.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

This further concession reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership and brings us very close to a final agreement. We truly value the deep bond between our companies and look forward to continuing our shared work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
